question: If the height and the radius of a solid right circular cylinder are doubled, find the percentage increase in its volume.
solution:
The correct answer is __**700%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The formula for the volume of a right circular cylinder πr²h;
 
• where π= 22/7,
 
 
• r= radius of the cylinder, and
 
• h= height. 
 
 
 
• The volume of the original cylinder is πr²h. 
 
• The volume of the new cylinder will be π(2r)²(2h)= π4r²2h= 8πr2h. 
 
• Increment in volume = 8πr²h- πr2h= 7πr2h. 
 
• Percentage increase= (7πr2h/πr2h)x100 =** 700 % **
